This release uses unmodified @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7, a JavaScript MP3 encoder, under LGPL-3.0. Copyright and license are included in LICENSE.txt. Matching library source: https://github.com/shijinyu/lamejs and https://registry.npmjs.org/@breezystack/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.7.tgz . The encoder is built as a separate dynamically loaded bundle. Users may replace/rebuild the library module with a compatible version.
